provenance.source: hand-written shortest winning path on the standard 4x4 map, recorded with gym/worker.py
provenance.environment: FrozenLake-v1 is part of Gymnasium itself; `pip install gymnasium[toy-text]` adds only the optional renderer
provenance.actions: a0 left, a1 down, a2 right, a3 up; the map is SFFF/FHFH/FFFH/HFFG
provenance.determinism: is_slippery false removes every stochastic transition, so the path is exact under any seed
provenance.note: Reward 1.0 is cumulativeReward 1000: Playproof evidence is integer-only, so the worker scales reward by 1000.
